item.title: Overview of Jonah - The Scandalous Mercy of God 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # You know what it is like to carry something quietly, a tension, a reluctance, a calling you did not ask for. It sits in your chest like a weight you keep shifting from one side to the other, hoping it will settle, hoping it will fade. You go about your days, doing what is expected, showing up where you must, but inside there is a conversation you have not finished, a question you have not answered, a nudge from God you have not welcomed.
